title: 韩国顺差创纪录：韩元却意外贬值，资本流动成主导
speaker: Ri Chang-yong

segments.en: Well, I was in the office. I thought that there is a structural change in Korean FX market.
segments.zh: 我在任时就认为，韩国外汇市场正经历结构性变化。

segments.en: First of all, like any other advanced economist these days, Korea's FX movement is driven by the financial flows rather than trade surplus, trade flows.
segments.zh: 与其他发达经济体一样，韩元汇率更多由金融资本流动驱动，而非贸易顺差或贸易流。

segments.en: For example, in the last first half of this year, Korea has historically unprecedented current consumption surplus due to the semi-conducting super-cycle, but the exchange rate depreciates significantly because fully investor took the money out to realize their gains.
segments.zh: 例如今年上半年，半导体超级周期带来历史性经常项目顺差，但外资获利了结、资金流出，韩元仍明显走弱。
